title: Pre-registered Pure-Geometry Selection and Conditioned Uncertainty Protocol for Jardim Garcia and Perozzo 2024 Real Outcrop Multi-Fracture Clusters

site_A_jardim_garcia.frame_resolution_rule: If candidate_generator contains support_refit, reconstruct exact local frame from original points.ply support indices (origin = mean of unique points rounded to 1e-12, basis = canonical_basis(plane_local.normal)) to avoid stale surface_geometry frame_local; otherwise use artifacts.workbench_scene.candidates[fragment_id].

spatial_adjacency_rule.metric: 3D AABB Euclidean gap between primary finite regions

site_A_jardim_garcia.seed_selection_rule: First seed = eligible single-hole fragment with largest real hole area (guaranteeing real-hole preservation coverage without connectivity peeking); remaining 5 seeds = deterministic farthest-point sampling maximizing minimum 3D centroid distance to already chosen seeds, tie-break by fragment_id.
site_A_jardim_garcia.cluster_growth_rule: Seed + (K-1) nearest neighbors in the AABB<=0.50m spatial graph ordered by (aabb_gap_m, centroid_dist_m, fragment_id).

seed_stratification_rule.method: 2x2 spatial quadrants split by median (Ycenter, Zcenter) of eligible seeds; 4 seeds per quadrant = 16 clusters
seed_stratification_rule.first_seed_in_quadrant: candidate closest to quadrant median spatial degree, tie-break by xlsx row
seed_stratification_rule.subsequent_seeds_in_quadrant: deterministic farthest-point in 3D center space subject to max Jaccard fracture overlap <= 0.15 with previously chosen clusters (fallback <= 0.30 only if exhausted)

site_B_perozzo_2024.cluster_growth_rule: Seed + (K-1) nearest neighbors ordered by (center_dist - (R_i + R_j), center_dist, xlsx_row).

conditioned_polygon_model.in_plane_axis_alignment: projected principal axis of geometrically bound DXF trace (fallback canonical_basis)

dxf_binding_audit.method: nearest DXF polyline centroid in 3D (purely geometric, never row index)

endpoint_selection_rule.pair_selection: Select anchor fracture pair (f_A, f_B) maximizing 3D centroid distance among pairs with positive nominal pairwise separation (Jardim: 3D AABB gap > 0; Perozzo: center_dist > R_i + R_j), fallback to overall maximum centroid distance pair if every pair overlaps. Purely pairwise geometry, blind to multi-hop connectivity.
endpoint_selection_rule.point_placement_jardim: Exact rational centroid (v0+v1+v2)/3 of the largest-area triangulated triangle of f_A (and f_B), strictly inside observed rock face and never in a hole.
endpoint_selection_rule.point_placement_perozzo: Exact rational quantized plane center c_q of f_A (and f_B), lying on the central octagon diagonal (v0, v4) and invariant under radial scaling.
endpoint_selection_rule.anchor_fractures_kinematics: Anchor fractures f_A and f_B have fixed velocity v = [0, 0, 0] and are excluded from tilt perturbation so fixed observation endpoints A and B remain attached across all (mode, t).

continuous_parameter.residual_scale_jardim: mean(|residuals|) + std(|residuals|) from real project.json point-to-plane residuals
continuous_parameter.interior_velocity_sign_rule: Sort interior fractures (excluding f_A, f_B) by scalar projection along unit(B - A), tie-break by fracture_id; even index -> +1, odd index -> -1; v_i = snap_1e4(sign_i * k * sigma_i * n_i).

pythagorean_exact_tilt.axis: local in-plane u-axis through f2 centroid
